source_overall_rank.warning: FantasyCalc can publish the same overallRank for multiple assets; never use as a unique key.

Rank.usage: deterministic repository row order and list-length-aware percentiles
Rank.normalization: source_overall_rank ascending, then value descending, then source_asset_id

expert_market_gap.definition: FantasyPros percentile minus FantasyCalc percentile on a scale where higher is better
expert_market_gap.positive_interpretation: Experts value the asset relatively higher than the observed trade market
expert_market_gap.negative_interpretation: The observed trade market values the asset relatively higher than experts

market_win_now_gap.definition: FantasyCalc redraft percentile minus FantasyCalc dynasty percentile on a scale where higher is better
market_win_now_gap.positive_interpretation: Current-season market value is relatively stronger than long-term market value
market_win_now_gap.negative_interpretation: Long-term market value is relatively stronger than current-season market value

league_adjustments: Apply six-team replacement-level context after reading the eight-team source proxy.
Apply additional scarcity for two fixed quarterback starters.
Apply additional scarcity for two fixed tight-end starters without pretending that TEP scoring models the same effect.
Do not use FantasyCalc values as an automatic trade grade.
limitations: FantasyCalc does not publish a source-updated timestamp in the values payload.
FantasyCalc overallRank can contain duplicate values and is not a unique identifier.
The public format request does not model the number of fixed tight-end starters.
Market values may reflect trade behavior, liquidity and participant composition rather than future fantasy production.
Optional payload fields can be absent or change without a documented schema version.
